snippet.title: INCISION - Launch Date Reveal
snippet.description:
INCISION - FINAL CUT CONFIRMED

INCISION, the no-bullshit and unapologetic gory boomer shooter is releasing this on 28th of August.  It has been three years of updates, patches and fixes. Through that period the game’s content grew to include 10 unique weapons (all with creative alt-fires), 16 gore-crusted enemies, 6 glorious boss encounters, 15 dripping with theme levels and 7 retro-radical 90’s cutscenes. 

Read more about the launch in this Steam Post: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1734680/view/771923598216528767

#boomershooter #gaming #fps #gamescom #gamescom2025
